mapper.select: select * from parent p join parent_student ps on p.parent_no = ps.parent_no where p.account_no = #{accountNo}

select p.parent_no as parentNo, ps.student_no as studentNo, ps.relationship as relationship, a.account_no as accountNo, a.account_id as accountId, a.account_name as accountName, a.account_phone as accountPhone, a.account_status as accountStatus from parent_student ps join parent p on ps.parent_no = p.parent_no join account a on p.account_no = a.account_no where ps.student_no = #{studentNo}

select p.parent_no as parentNo, a.account_no as accountNo, a.account_id as accountId, a.account_name as accountName, a.account_phone as accountPhone from parent p join account a on p.account_no = a.account_no where a.account_name like '%' || #{keyword} || '%' or a.account_phone like '%' || #{keyword} || '%'
